verses.1: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.2: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
verses.3: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.
verses.4: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
verses.5: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.
verses.6: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.
verses.7: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.8: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.
verses.9: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.
verses.10: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted amongst the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
verses.11: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
